title: Political research evidence model
status: Independent editorial ontology; no official UN endorsement

classes.label: Source Profile
classes.definition: A documented publishing identity and collection profile.
classes.scope_note: Keep existing source IDs. Do not automatically classify an outlet as a political actor.

classes.label: Document
classes.definition: A particular public source resource or version.
classes.scope_note: Keep canonical URL and existing document ID. In an RDF export, distinguish the source resource from its locally created receipt.

classes.label: Document Receipt
classes.definition: The locally created metadata record and collection history.
classes.scope_note: The receipt’s creation/retrieval time is not the publication time of the source document.

classes.label: Legal Instrument
classes.definition: A source-identified resolution, agreement or other instrument.
classes.scope_note: Instrument kind, issuer and symbol require source evidence. Legal force, amendment, entry into force and present applicability are separate assertions.

classes.label: Public Actor
classes.definition: A source-identified public institution, organization or professional public person.
classes.scope_note: Keep actor identity separate from publisher identity; do not instantiate private individuals. Offices, role holders and role dates require qualified assertions, not permanent inferred affiliations.

classes.label: Political Process
classes.definition: A documented process reference with explicit geographic and temporal scope.
classes.scope_note: Do not turn a document’s proposal into an actually operating process.

classes.label: Process Episode
classes.definition: A proposed, announced or reported meeting, consultation or negotiation episode.
classes.scope_note: Keep occurrence status, source date, event date and participant claims distinct.

classes.label: Normative Objective
classes.definition: An aim, requested action or proposed arrangement expressed by a document.
classes.scope_note: Use for the 2254 exemplar so governance, elections and ceasefire objectives do not become unqualified current-world facts.

classes.label: Assertion
classes.definition: An attributed statement or assessment, optionally with a subject/predicate/object structure.
classes.scope_note: Existing textual claims remain valid. Add structured triples only when the statement can be faithfully represented.

classes.label: Evidence Link
classes.definition: A document and locator tied to a particular assertion, with a stated evidence relationship.
classes.scope_note: Preserve existing document_id and locator; add supports_paraphrase / qualifies / contradicts / mentions, never an implied truth guarantee.

classes.label: Review Activity
classes.definition: A collection, annotation, extraction or review operation.
classes.scope_note: Record who or what performed it, its inputs and actual execution time. Do not invent a human reviewer.

classes.label: Review Decision
classes.definition: A versioned record of a review outcome and rationale.
classes.scope_note: Keep decision history; a current review label does not erase previous evidence.

classes.label: Concept
classes.definition: A controlled analytical term, distinct from a person, institution, place or event.
classes.scope_note: Use a shared scheme plus a Syria profile; multilingual labels are not entity-identity assertions.

classes.label: Place Reference
classes.definition: A named geographic scope, with optional existing navigation anchor.
classes.scope_note: Retain the current point basis and scope. A navigation point is not an incident geotag, political boundary or sovereignty claim.

classes.label: Institution or organization
classes.definition: A source-identified public institution or organization.
classes.scope_note: Roles and mandates require dated assertions.

classes.label: Public person
classes.definition: A public professional actor identified in a source.
classes.scope_note: Office, holder and role dates stay separate. No private-person profiles are supplied.

classes.label: Constituency reference
classes.definition: A constituency as described by a particular source.
classes.scope_note: A representation claim does not establish legitimacy, consent or exhaustive representation.

relations.label: published by
relations.meaning: The publishing entity of a source document. The legacy evidence graph uses the inverse source-to-document direction.

relations.label: supported by
relations.meaning: A qualified source relationship, not a bare claim of truth.

relations.label: requests
relations.meaning: The instrument explicitly requests an action; retain addressee and exact source verb.

relations.label: expresses support for
relations.meaning: Support expressed in the document; does not assert implementation.

relations.label: calls for
relations.meaning: Use only when this accurately represents the source wording; do not normalize every diplomatic verb to calls_for.

relations.label: has documented mandate
relations.meaning: Evidence describes a role/mandate, with the instrument and time scope retained.

relations.label: convenes
relations.meaning: Source reports actual convening; a request to convene belongs in requests instead.

relations.label: mediates
relations.meaning: A source describes a specific mediation role; distinguish the mandate, acceptance by parties and reported activity.

relations.label: invited to
relations.meaning: An evidenced invitation, not proof of attendance.

relations.label: participates in
relations.meaning: Participation is documented; role, date and source retained. Attendance does not establish representation of a population.

relations.label: consulted in
relations.meaning: The source describes consultation, separately from negotiation membership or decision-making authority.

relations.label: described as representing
relations.meaning: A particular source’s representation claim; no automatic claim of legitimacy, consent or exhaustive representation.

relations.label: explicitly references instrument
relations.meaning: An explicit document citation, not amendment, legal precedence or implementation.

relations.label: facilitates
relations.meaning: A documented facilitation role, distinct from mediation, convening or participation.

standards.name: PROV-O
standards.use: Provenance of records, collection and review, not political influence.

standards.name: SKOS
standards.use: Controlled analytical concepts, not entity identity.

standards.name: Dublin Core Terms
standards.use: Source document metadata, not political mediation.

standards.name: JSON-LD 1.1
standards.use: Offline, inline-context RDF statement reification with country-qualified identifiers.

export_policy: Political relationships are qualified assertions. JSON-LD names RDF statements without emitting their unqualified political triples.
